Auth (single-user + register/login), Accounts CRUD, Bills + summary, Credit Cards + report, Investments + headings + portfolio/analytics, Rentals, Loans, Lending, Budgets + progress, Reminders, Notes + note-headings, Dashboard, Net Worth, Cashflow Analytics, Settings, Family Members - all working. rca of the issue: RCA of prior fixed bug: firebase_config.py update_one used elif between $set/$inc branches, silently dropping $inc when both were present. Since server.py combines them (e.g. db.accounts.update_one({...}, {'$inc': {'balance': amount}, '$set': {'updated_at': now}})), balance never updated. Fix: independent if blocks. Verified: regression tests now show exact balance deltas on CREATE(+/-), UPDATE(diff applied), DELETE(revert).
